notes.title: Beta Version 0.4
notes.content:
Swim Meet Beta 0.4 is live:
- Updated the 'leave' area options on the map choices
- Updated the image and text when choosing to explore the map.
- Added background illustrations to each of the explorable locations.
- Added options to explore different areas inside the park: Zoo and Forest Walkway.
- Added various options to buy food within the park.
